name: french-math-asr-benchmark
description: A French-language audio benchmark focused on automatic speech recognition (ASR) for spoken mathematics problems and expressions. It measures how well ASR systems transcribe numerals, mathematical terms, and formulas spoken in French, including domain-specific pronunciations and mixed numeric/alphanumeric content. The dataset is intended to evaluate transcription accuracy for educational and math-related speech scenarios.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and useful for niche French math-ASR research; limited broad adoption to date.
